verdict.rationale: Auto-generating per-release changelogs is a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies. The pack shows no release, versioning or changelog feature. Message boards, Automatic Check-ins and the REST API/CLI are adjacent features or developer building blocks that a user could use to build such a changelog, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
